rules.finding: PROTOCOL_REJECT_OBSERVED with the 5GMM Cause supplied by nas-5gs
rules.basis: TS 24.501 service-request procedure: Service reject carries a 5GMM cause

rules.finding: Service-access accept observation recorded; no further completion expectation is asserted
rules.basis: TS 23.502 service-request procedure: Service accept concludes the observed service-access exchange

rules.condition: Service request observed and neither Service accept nor Service reject appears before capture end
rules.finding: MISSING_EXPECTED_COUNTERPART with the capture-boundary limitation; the accept is not asserted as mandatory in every context
rules.basis: TS 23.502 service-request handling depends on context; only the reject/accept observations are definitive

rules.finding: Paging observation recorded; paging itself is not evidence that the UE responded
rules.basis: TS 23.502 paging: the N2 observation does not include the air-interface response

rules.condition: Paging observed and no subsequent service/access evidence appears before capture end
rules.finding: MISSING_EXPECTED_COUNTERPART reported as 'paging response evidence not observed within the available observation window'; paging failure is never concluded
rules.basis: TS 23.502 paging: the UE response occurs on the air interface, outside the N1/N2 capture scope
